Scope: Finite same-machine diagnostic run; four pinned community binaries, isolated configuration and owned text, normal GC, no forced collections. Default sampling-only run uses direct production worker logic and response resource checks. Interactive opt-in uses private desktops and includes the test dialog-driver timer; known third-party modal resource growth may fail its budgets. Per-worker budgets: +32 kernel handles, +8 GDI, +8 USER, +64 MiB private memory. Not an hours/days soak or hardware/driver certification.
